notes.subject: רוח
notes.rationale: Rendered 'ruak' per discipline — one word covering Spirit/wind/breath; no 'spirit' alone.

notes.subject: תבינם
notes.rationale: Singular verb with plural suffix: 'it gives them understanding' — who is 'them' (the aged? all?) is disputed.

notes.subject: ol samting
notes.rationale: Object of understanding implied in verb suffix; supplied in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: source of wisdom
notes.rationale: Verse reveals that understanding comes not from age but from Sadai's breath — a disclosed hidden principle.

translation: Tasol ruak, em i stap long man, na win bilong Sadai, em i mekim ol man i save skelim ol samting.

tokens.gloss: i mekim ol man i save skelim ol samting
